meta.title: Replace HashMap/HashSet with FxHasher versions across Rspack codebase
meta.body_summary: Replace std HashMap/HashSet with FxHasher equivalents across the Rspack codebase to improve hash performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin replaced HashMap/HashSet with FxHasher across 40 files; CodSpeed benchmark reported no performance alteration; PR closed shortly after without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 172 changed lines across 40 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume, touching many files but with minimal per‑file diff. It is a systematic hash‑map replacement intended for performance, but the PR was closed—not merged—after a CI benchmark showed no performance gain.

review_details.concern_detail: CodSpeed CI performance report indicates that merging this PR will not alter performance (12 untouched benchmarks), contradicting the performance claim.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve hash performance by using FxHasher instead of the default hasher.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after CodSpeed benchmark reported no performance alteration; maintainer hardfist closed without comment.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A broad, cross‑crate hasher replacement in a Rust build tool; without benchmarks or profiling data, the performance claim was not validated, and CI benchmarks refuted it. Merge required measurable improvement.

detection_detail.ci_auto: CodSpeed bot ran performance benchmarks comparing the PR branch against main and reported that merging will not alter performance (12 untouched benchmarks).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body contains only a narrative claim; CodSpeed provided post‑hoc benchmark but no reproducible steps or before/after metrics from the author.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No performance regression occurred; PR closed because expected improvement was not observed. The author/maintainer hardfist closed the PR after the benchmark report.

core_change_summary.description: In 40 files across Rspack crates, replaced `std::collections::HashMap`/`HashSet` imports with `rustc_hash::FxHashMap`/`FxHashSet` via `use rustc_hash::{FxHashMap as HashMap, FxHashSet as HashSet}`; adapted initialization from `HashMap::new()` to `HashMap::default()` for FxHashMap compatibility; updated affected `Cargo.toml` files to add `rustc-hash` dependency.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Remaining source files (30+) have 2‑6 line diffs each, mostly import changes and `HashMap::new()` → `HashMap::default()` fixes.
change_trajectory: Single commit replacing HashMap/HashSet with FxHasher across 40 files, adding rustc-hash deps and fixing initialization.
